summary: Busy Witton Road kerb with no parked cars and no stopping signs.

drivers.seclusion: Gym 18 m and houses on the east side within about 15 m; open to the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside a through lane with a fringe of verge and trees; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial approaching a junction and roundabout.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along this kerb; three No Stopping Any Time signs.

flags: Low-lying: 4 m elevation, Witton Creek 67 m away
sun_shade: Trees and house shade the east side; open to afternoon sun from the west.
